_about: Public-domain Robert Sanderson (1587-1663, Regius Professor of Divinity at Oxford, Bishop of Lincoln, casuist, author of the preface to the 1662 Book of Common Prayer) for the Word Hoard: his Works, edited by William Jacobson (6 vols, Oxford 1854), raw Internet Archive OCR. Vols. 4 and 6 are mostly Latin (the Oxford lectures on oaths and on conscience; the logic compendium). Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 13 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
